description: The bursts of reports the user can see, newest first: those of Rollstack reports, whose variants differ by report parameters, and those of older reports such as Google Slides or PowerPoint files, whose variants differ by filters, as kind says. Each comes with what its variants differ by and the template report they are copied from. You can filter by name, ignoring case. Answers up to limit bursts, 50 by default and 200 at most, and a nextCursor: pass it as cursor for the next page, until it is null. listReports leaves out the reports of a burst, its template and variants.

query.description: Options for the call, such as filters, paging or how long to wait

cursor.description: Where to continue the list: pass the `nextCursor` returned with the previous page to get the next one. Omit it for the first page.

limit.description: Maximum number of bursts to return on this page, from 1 to 200. Defaults to `50`.

name.description: Only return bursts whose name contains this text, ignoring case: `region` matches `Regional Review`.

name: listBursts
title: List bursts
